title: Enforce the exit-code and error-output contract
goal: Failures have to behave predictably for a tool that gets used in scripts: the right exit code, the explanation on stderr, and nothing at all on stdout. A caller piping stdout must never receive an error message mixed into its data.
acceptance: A missing or malformed run directory exits 2
A readable but empty run exits 1
On every failing path stdout is completely empty
On every failing path the explanation goes to stderr
